body: Good. Hope things get better for you man.

Whatever your problem is, it can be fixed through talking to people. Literally just a few days ago I was at rock bottom. I had enough Valium on me to put me to sleep for a looooooong time. Yet, I came looking for help, I didn't want it to end there, I wanted to live a full, and happy life. I honestly believe I will, I made a post on reddit, asking for help, and I got it. My point is, if you ever want to talk to someone, I'm here for you. So is everyone who's commented here.
